name: One Night Ultimate Werewolf
summary: One-night social deduction where hidden roles may be swapped at night before players discuss and vote to kill a Werewolf.
rules_text: Setup: Shuffle roles, deal one face-down to each player plus three extra face-down in center. Players secretly view own card. Night occurs in fixed role order called by announcer: Werewolves open eyes to see each other. Seer may look at one other player's card or two center cards. Robber may swap his card with another player's and look at new card. Troublemaker may swap two other players' cards without looking. Then all wake; your current card in front of you is your final team. Day: Players discuss without showing cards, claiming and bluffing about what happened. After discussion, all simultaneously point to vote to kill one player. Most votes dies, ties kill all tied; if everyone gets at most one vote, no one dies. Village team wins if at least one Werewolf dies, or if no Werewolves exist and no one dies. Werewolf team wins if at least one Werewolf exists and no Werewolf dies. Tanner etc. alter wins.
